versions.content: The detection of an incomplete write operation to a NV block is out of scope of the Nv M module. This is handled and detected by the memory hardware abstraction. The NvM module expects to get information from the memory hardware abstraction if a referenced NV block is invalid or inconsistent and cannot be read when requested. SW - Cs may use N vM_InvalidateNvBlock to prevent lower layers from delivering old data.
